name: 蔷薇露水乳保湿两件套款
description: 水瓶乳瓶双瓶组合叙事，玫瑰花瓣柔粉体系，早晚水乳两步保湿

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless warm ivory #FBF6F0 and misty rose #F4DCD6 paper fields, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust, deep rose-plum #6B2D4F reserved for the closing shot only
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting, large diffused front-left key, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm ivory paper #FBF6F0 and rose-mist board #F4DCD6, one polished white porcelain slab for macro work
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and blank hairline label rails in the plum accent #6B2D4F only
styleLock.presentationRules: upright bottles at stable scale; hero angle is a slight 3/4; macro and overhead shots vary rhythm
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft floral premium skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory #FBF6F0, misty rose #F4DCD6, deep rose-plum accent #6B2D4F and warm umber text #3E342C; warm soft studio lighting with a large diffused front-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icon and hairline label style in the plum accent only; clean high-end skincare photography with flowing satin and fresh rose props; upright bottles at stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼看清双瓶组合，干净合规抢点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, both bottles standing upright side by side, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, diffused front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: none, product centered with even margin
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a matching toner and emulsion bottle pair. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, both bottles standing upright side by side, full product visible, neither clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a diffused front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the bottles. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, no props. The product pair occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace. 8K commercial skincare e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no petals, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background, no cut-off edges, no floating bottles.

shots.intent: 一秒传达补水保湿的核心利益，承接主图点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, product group on the lower left
shots.lighting: warm soft diffused front-left key, gentle falloff, soft contact shadow
shots.background: misty rose field #F4DCD6 with one flowing ivory satin drape along the lower edge
shots.props: one flowing champagne-ivory satin drape, one fresh deep-rose bloom with leaves placed low behind the bottles
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper 35% for a headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The product pair shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the lower left, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Warm soft diffused front-left key light with gentle falloff and a soft contact shadow. Background is a misty rose field #F4DCD6 with one flowing champagne-ivory satin drape along the lower edge; one fresh deep-rose bloom with leaves sits low behind the bottles, not covering any label. Generous negative space in the upper 35% reserved for a short headline 「{selling_point_1}」. Negative: no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented efficacy claims or percentages, no watermark, no fake logo, no petals covering the product.

shots.intent: 放大换季干渴、上妆卡粉的缺水痛点，引出产品
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flatter and duller; right panel warm soft key, same direction both sides
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, panels fill the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing and crop. Left panel: an abstract patch of tight, dull, dehydrated skin texture under flatter duller light, conveying post-cleansing tightness without any real face. Right panel: {product} with one bottle uncapped, standing in the same framing under warm soft light conveying comfort. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Warm ivory background #FBF6F0 on both panels, one small blank oval label rail at the foot of each panel carrying 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. The product occupies 50-60% per panel, no extra whitespace. Negative: no real model face, no fabricated before-after results, no percentages or statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用清爽流动的水质质地特写证明肤感轻盈不黏
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, shallow depth of field, foreground liquid sharp
shots.lighting: warm skimming light from the right revealing the liquid surface and fine texture
shots.props: a single poured pool of clear liquid on the porcelain only
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a poured pool of clear watery texture from {product}, tight zoom on the liquid surface with one slow drip mid-fall. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground liquid sharp. Warm skimming light from the right revealing the fine texture of the liquid. Polished white porcelain slab background #FFFFFF, the poured pool is the only prop. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, minimal whitespace, the texture is the subject. A thin 「{callout_3}」 rail sits in the lower right corner. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking liquid, no fabricated ingredient claims or percentages, no splash crown, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入清晨梳妆台真实使用情境，强化早晚两步习惯

shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle falloff, soft contact shadow
shots.background: warm ivory wall #FBF6F0 above a rose-mist matte vanity board #F4DCD6
shots.props: one folded ivory hand towel and one small unbranded glass cup at the far edge, not covering the product
shots.whitespace: soft breathing room around the product, no text margin needed
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} arranged on a rose-mist matte vanity board #F4DCD6 in a morning dressing corner. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a side profile eye-level view across the vanity with a candid handheld feel, the two bottles as the clear subject. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, gentle falloff and a soft contact shadow. Warm ivory wall #FBF6F0 behind. Props: one folded ivory hand towel and one small unbranded glass cup at the far edge, not covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with soft breathing room around it. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no clutter, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no impossible shadows.

shots.intent: 俯视图解水乳两步顺序，消除怎么用的疑虑

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow

shots.intent: 俯瞰整套内含物与包装组合，降低到手预期差

shots.lighting: even clean studio light, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars

shots.props: one thin ivory hairline oval framing the pair, one empty rounded button placeholder, no text rendered

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 粉调花瓣主视觉双瓶(水+乳)与功效文案带；P2 单品参数表与『99%肌肤问题由缺水引起』痛点圆图；P3 水瓶放射卖点圆标(补充/平衡/弹性等)；P4 乳瓶卖点圆标与玫瑰花瓣；P5 双瓶三段功效文案；P6-P7 三组真人前后对比(干枯发黄/垃圾堆积/松弛)；P7末-P8 成分数字步骤(1-6编号圆)与三步涂抹手法插画；P8-P10 产品实拍(白底双瓶、粉盒+单瓶、双盒+双瓶全家福)与入会二维码促销贴片。品类判定：主体为爽肤水+乳液两件套，属护肤个护/面部护理，与源夹名一致；硬证据为瓶身品类字样、早晚洁面后水-乳-面霜步骤文案、两瓶规格参数区。已剥离：品牌名与花体字标、韩文标签、原功效文案原句、成分名称与任何含量数字、99%类统计、真人模特面容与前后对比人像、手法插画人脸、原文规格数值(改为{callout_n})、入会促销角标与二维码、粉盒包装美术(仅保留素色无字长盒结构)。与库内近似模版差异(查重 _sources/registry.md 护肤个护/面部护理 41 件)：1) 色板全新——象牙暖白 #FBF6F0 / 玫瑰雾粉 #F4DCD6 / 深蔷薇梅 #6B2D4F / 暖褐墨 #3E342C，全库 grep 无命中，库内粉调件用 #F7E9EA #F6D9D0 #F0CFD6 等均不复用；2) 背景与道具体系全新——流拽象牙缎布+鲜玫瑰花朵+白瓷台面+素色无字深梅纸盒，库内已用水花气泡、珍珠、冰块、毛巾托盘、棕榈叶、云朵泡沫座等一律避开；3) 机位体系全新——低于瓶身中段的仰角套组镜(shot-08)、90度俯拍两步图解(shot-07)、高45度俯瞰全家福(shot-09)、侧视梳台(shot-05)，库内通行的 straight-level/slight-hero/flat-frontal 序列不复用；4) 角色序列 HERO>HERO>PAIN_POINT>DETAIL>SCENE>COMPARISON>DETAIL>VARIANT>TRUST>CTA 与库内 41 件均不相同；5) 版式元件全新——梅色发丝线椭圆轨、空白印章框、三空白步骤圆、空按钮位，避开花体警告圆标/数字玻璃珠/六边形卡等既有元件。temperature 取 warm 与库内多件相同，按 brief 第 3 节以色板/道具/机位/角色/元件五处差异区分。
